meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Drives dependency-ordered child work through the native workflow tool, one run per phase with retry/amend/send recovery. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, or fan-out work where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按依赖顺序分阶段推进多步骤任务,出错可重试或修改后继续。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要让多个互有先后依赖的任务按序自动推进。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent subtasks in phases, with retry and repair on failure.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to push groups of ordered tasks automatically.

howto.what: 它把有先后依赖的任务拆成节点图,按依赖分波并行跑子代理,一个 run 只覆盖一个阶段。某个节点失败或跑偏时,可以只重试它、给它发消息或改定义,已完成节点的结果保留、不重跑。
howto.when: 当你提到 mass-ulw、任务 DAG 或分阶段扇出等说法,或任务之间存在真实依赖(某项工作必须等另外几项先完成)时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把这次文档更新拆成依赖图跑一遍
say.note: 会先读规划文档,再定义并启动图

say.text: 重试那个失败的节点,顺便改一下它的指令
say.note: 只重跑该节点,已完成的沿用缓存

say.text: 给正在跑的 lint 节点发消息:跳过 vendored 目录
say.note: 就地改变该子代理的行为

howto.what_en: Splits your request into a dependency-ordered node graph and runs child agents in parallel waves; one run covers one phase. A failed or drifting node can be retried, messaged or amended without re-running finished nodes.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for mass-ulw, a task DAG or staged fan-out, or when tasks genuinely depend on each other (one task must wait for two others to finish).

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to run this docs update as a dependency graph
say_en.note: reads the planning doc first, then defines the graph

say_en.text: Retry the failed node and edit its instruction while you're at it
say_en.note: only that node re-runs; finished ones are reused

say_en.text: Send the running lint node: skip the vendored dir
